What do these filters mean?

Type identifies the organisation or role. Scoring describes how results are reported. Instructions indicate whether the publisher provides enough detail to repeat the test. Sources identify the publisher; use its current rules before attempting an assessment.

Specialist selection research

Official public recruitment and fitness information, not complete selection courses. These sources are not scored or compared as equivalent tests.

Kystjeger — KJK (Coastal Ranger Command)

Forsvaret. (n.d.). Kystjeger — KJK (Coastal Ranger Command). Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

Norwegian coastal ranger recruitment and public entry requirements; not U.S. SFAS.

Marinejeger — MJK (Naval Special Operations Commando)

Forsvaret. (n.d.). Marinejeger — MJK (Naval Special Operations Commando). Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

Official Norwegian recruitment pathway; use the applicable intake requirements.

Spesialjeger — FSK (Special Operations Commando)

Forsvaret. (n.d.). Spesialjeger — FSK (Special Operations Commando). Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

Official Norwegian selection pathway, separate from MJK and KJK.

Special Forces — Green Berets / SFAS / 18X

U.S. Army. (n.d.). Special Forces — Green Berets / SFAS / 18X. Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

Army Special Forces Assessment and Selection is a specific military course, not a generic name for all selection tests.

Navy Special Operations Physical Screening Test — SEAL / PST

U.S. Navy. (n.d.). Navy Special Operations Physical Screening Test — SEAL / PST. Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

Public screening information, not the full SEAL selection or training course. The Navy differentiates minimum and elevated standards.

Pararescue — PJ

U.S. Air Force. (n.d.). Pararescue — PJ. Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

Public recruitment and training pathway. Check the relevant current Initial Fitness Test (IFT); historical PAST documents are not interchangeable.

Recrutement et formation — GIGN

Gendarmerie nationale. (n.d.). Recrutement et formation — GIGN. Retrieved November 24, 2026, from Original source · Wayback capture index

French gendarmerie recruitment pathways. The public recruitment page does not establish a complete standardised fitness test.

Unconfirmed assessment details

Delta Force / 1st SFOD-D, DEVGRU / Naval Special Warfare Development Group, and the ambiguous name “Recon Rangers” are research leads. We have not verified complete public selection fitness standards. US Army Rangers, Marine Reconnaissance and Air Force Special Reconnaissance are distinct pathways; do not conflate them.

If you know of an official public test protocol or have relevant first-hand experience, let us hear from you. Do not send restricted or sensitive information.

Archive links are capture indexes, not verified snapshots.
